The suite calls the shipped journal classes and private fixture equality join without a broker. It does not substitute for CotalEndpoint or native callout reachability.

This metadata partition is source preparation only. Maintained admission must still be applied by the sanctioned workflow before execution. Four live targets remain explicitly refused in diagnostic-auth-journal.json.
